clips.title: The story
paras: Bashal'Aran lies in northern Darkshore, east of Auberdine, where satyrs and grells feed on lingering magic. A solitary elven ghost remains trapped by a centuries-old curse.

Before the Great Sundering shattered ancient Kalimdor ten thousand years ago, Queen Azshara settled favored Highborne in Bashal'Aran and its twin, Ameth'Aran. The powerful mage Athrikus Narassin governed both towns, whose splendid markets and temples honored Elune. When the Well of Eternity collapsed, the cataclysm destroyed the settlements. For reasons lost to time, Athrikus used his arcane mastery to bind his second-in-command, the mage Asterion, in a moonstone seal within Bashal'Aran. Asterion's body perished, but his ghost remained shackled to the ruined shrine.

Deth'ryll satyrs and grells now claim Bashal'Aran's crumbled stones. Drawn by magic lingering in the ancient masonry, these corrupted beings feed on its energy to strengthen their foul arts. They swarm the broken courtyards and terrorize travelers on Darkshore's forest paths, yet keep clear of the central shrine, where Asterion endures his endless vigil.
